# DocInspector

> DocInspector is a free, privacy-first **batch document processing, M&A Cleanroom, security & audit suite**. Upload up to 100 files or multi-folder directory trees at once, select multiple operations simultaneously, and process all files in a single pass. Online processing runs in an isolated encrypted sandbox in Germany (EU) with immediate zero-retention deletion after download. Also available as a **desktop application for Windows** (100% offline, air-gapped security).

## Core Capabilities & Unique Pipeline

Most document tools process **one file with one tool**. DocInspector processes **many files across entire directory trees using multiple tools simultaneously in a single pass**.

- **Multi-Folder Upload**: Upload up to 100 files or entire directory trees (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, images, PPTX).
- **Multi-Operation Pipeline**: Select multiple operations simultaneously (e.g. Sanitize Metadata + Redact PDF + Remove Signatures + Encrypt + Convert to PDF + Audit Report) — all selected tools run sequentially on every file in one batch.
- **Folder Structure Preservation**: The output ZIP archive preserves the exact nested directory structure as uploaded.
- **M&A Cleanroom & VDR Due Diligence**: Prepare financial records, contracts, and IP for Virtual Data Rooms. Permanently strip hidden author metadata, GPS coordinates, revision history, and un-redacted PII.
- **Zero Retention Online**: EU server processing, immediate deletion upon download — never stored or used for AI training. GDPR compliant.
- **100% Offline Air-Gapped Desktop App**: Windows app with no file size limits, no internet connection required, and unlimited batch sizes.

## 10 Available Document Tools (Combinable in Batch)

| Operation | Description | Supported Formats |
|---|---|---|
| Sanitize Metadata | Remove all hidden metadata (author, dates, GPS, software, revision logs) | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT, Images, PPTX |
| Find & Redact | Permanently black out sensitive text and PII at the pixel level | PDF |
| Convert to PDF | Batch-convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Text, and Images to PDF | DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, Images |
| Remove Signatures | Strip digital signatures, certified locks, and editing restrictions | PDF |
| Rebuild & Repair PDF | Fix corrupted/broken PDF structures with built-in OCR for scans | PDF |
| Add Watermark | Stamp customizable text watermark ("CONFIDENTIAL", "M&A DUE DILIGENCE") | PDF |
| Encrypt PDF | Password-protect with 256-bit AES encryption and set permission locks | PDF |
| Flatten to Image PDF | Convert PDF pages into raster image PDFs (removes text layers & hidden vectors) | PDF |
| PDF Bundle Summary | Generate Excel+PDF+CSV dossier summary report (borderou/reestr) | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT |
| Advanced Bundle Report | Detailed audit report: file title, format, size, SHA-256 hash, protection, pages | PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT |
